name: WorkspaceAlberta
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: harness-server
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; pnpm dev:server

terminals.name: vite
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; pnpm dev
